summary_markdown: The discussion covered two main topics: the display of default demographics and calculating combined reach for multiple frames. Initially, [p1] questioned why default demographics were displayed on a project lacking defined demographics or campaigns. It was confirmed that the system uses default demographics based on 'areas of living' (AOL). Later, regarding frame data, [p1] sought clarification on how to calculate combined reach when multiple frames from one facility are selected. The current logic appears to use `max_va` across all selected frames within a single facility, rather than simply averaging or calculating the sum. The goal is ensuring that adding new frames does not decrease the overall calculated reach.
decisions: The system uses default demographics based on 'areas of living' (AOL) when specific campaign data is missing.
action_items: [me] updated the totals section in the analytics report on the staging environment for review.
